title: Yajamānam
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || || 2. Atha kho Sakko devānam indo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 3. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || Yajamānānaṃ manussānam || puññapekhānapāṇinaṃ || karotam opadhikaṃ puññaṃ || kattha dinnam mahapphalan ti || || 4. Cattāro ca paṭipannā || cattāro ca phale ṭhitā || esa saṅgho ujubhūto || paññāsīlasamāhito || || yajamānānam manussānam || puññapekhānapāṇinam || karotam opadhikaṃ puññaṃ || saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti || ||
